posts.description: Oh my, the Secrets Project is really fun and addictive!

Say hello to the Fediverse Drupal recipe! Understanding and configuring the ActivityPub module can be a tedious task. This recipe ships with sensible default configuration enabling you to set everything up in just one minute! See https://drupal.org/project/fediverse for more information. Quick demo in the video, it's pure magic!
Visited @Roy's exhibition at PixLife . Will be having fun with Lego this week :)
